title: Slovakian Creamy Potato and Leek Soup (Velvet Kiss)
description: A rich and comforting Slovakian-inspired creamy potato and leek soup, made with a kiss of love and a velvet touch.
instructions: 1. In a large pot, melt butter over medium heat.
2. Add chopped leeks and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
3. Add diced potatoes and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
4. Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
5. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.
6. Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
7. Stir in heavy cream and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until heated through.
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
9. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
10. Enjoy your delicious Slovakian Creamy Potato and Leek Soup!
